method: read-only whole-source review; the weight formula and per-day databases spot-checked
findings: All hot lists come from one third-party aggregator with a spoofed desktop user agent; returned URLs must match each source's domain
One database per day resets first-seen, last-seen and crawl counts daily; rank history keeps distinct ranks only; new items are detected by title while dedup is by URL
The analytics tools count daily title mentions; the sentiment tool returns a prompt instead of computing sentiment
LLM interest scores are stored without model provenance and the LLM briefing is shown without a model label
